nodes.description: Governable._governance / HATToken.governance: privileged address controlling pools, claims, swaps and governance transfer.
pendingApprovals[_pid]: committee claim (beneficiary, severity, approver) awaiting governance approval/dismissal; its presence also freezes withdrawals.
poolInfo[]: per-pool lpToken, allocPoint, lastRewardBlock, rewardPerShare, totalUsersAmount and balance.
swapAndBurns[token]: LP token amounts accounted for later swap-and-burn.
governanceHatRewards[token]: LP token amounts reserved to be swapped into HAT for governance.
hackersHatRewards[hacker][token]: LP token amounts reserved to be swapped into HAT for the hacker.
withdrawRequests[pid][user]: request timestamp that gates whether a withdrawal may be executed.
poolsRewards[pid]: rewards split, rewards levels, vesting params and committeeCheckIn flag.
generalParameters: withdraw/safety periods, vesting durations/periods, setRewardsLevelsDelay and claimFee.
pendingRewardsLevels[pid]: timelocked reward-level update waiting for confirmation.
HATToken.minters[minter]: remaining mint allowance consumed by HATMaster.updatePool.
HATToken.totalSupply, capped by CAP and 96-bit conversion.
HATToken.balances: internal 96-bit balance ledger updated by mint/burn/transfer.
TimelockController._timestamps[id]: scheduling/readiness timestamps for timelocked operations.
userInfo[pid][user]: user share amount and rewardDebt used for pending reward accounting.
committees[pid]: address authorised to raise claims and manage pool reward levels.
Immutable ITokenLockFactory used to deploy vesting token locks for hackers and HAT rewards.
Immutable ISwapRouter (Uniswap V3) used to swap LP tokens into HAT.
poolDepositPause[pid]: governance flag blocking new deposits into a pool.
HATToken HAT / _rewardsToken: reward token that is minted, burned, transferred and swapped.
HATVaults.deposit(pid, amount): external user entry point; clears withdraw request and delegates to _deposit.
HATVaults.withdraw(pid, shares): external user entry point; validates withdraw request then calls _withdraw.
HATVaults.emergencyWithdraw(pid): validates withdraw request then calls _emergencyWithdraw.
HATVaults.approveClaim(pid): governance-only, nonReentrant claim payout builder; creates token locks and performs multiple token transfers.
HATVaults.swapBurnSend(pid, beneficiary, amountOutMinimum, fees): swaps LP tokens to HAT, burns part and vests the rest.
HATVaults.claim(descriptionHash): payable claim registration that forwards the claim fee to governance.
HATVaults.addPool(...): governance-only pool registration validating vesting params, reward levels and split.
HATVaults.setPool(...): governance-only pool parameter update (allocPoint, registration, deposit pause).
Governable.setPendingGovernance(newGovernance): records a pending governance address and timestamp.
Governable.transferGovernorship(): completes governance handover after TIME_LOCK_DELAY.
HATVaults.pendingApprovalClaim(pid, beneficiary, severity): committee-only claim registration allowed only during the safety period.
HATVaults.setRewardsSplit(pid, split): governance-only update of reward distribution, validated to sum to 10000.
HATVaults.setPendingRewardsLevels(pid, levels): committee-only, starts the timelock for reward levels.
HATVaults.setRewardsLevels(pid): committee-only confirmation of pending reward levels after setRewardsLevelsDelay.
HATVaults.committeeCheckIn(pid): committee-only flag enabling deposits for the pool.
HATVaults.setCommittee(pid, committee): authorization depends on whether msg.sender is governance or the current committee.
HATVaults.rewardDepositors(pid, amount): permissionless top-up of pool balance via safeTransferFrom.
HATMaster.updatePool(pid): accrues rewardPerShare, caps reward by mint allowance and mints HAT.
HATMaster._deposit(pid, amount): nonReentrant accounting of user share, reward payout and LP pull.
HATMaster._withdraw(pid, amount): nonReentrant share burn, pending reward payout and LP return.
HATMaster._emergencyWithdraw(pid): withdraws pro-rata balance ignoring rewards; not nonReentrant.
HATMaster.safeTransferReward(to, amount, pid): best-effort HAT reward payout limited by contract balance.
HATVaults.swapTokenForHAT(...): approves the router and performs a Uniswap V3 exactInput path swap into HAT.
TimelockController.execute(...): role-gated execution of a ready timelocked operation.
TimelockController._call(...): performs an arbitrary external call with value and marks the operation done.
HATToken.mint(account, amount): minter-gated mint consuming the caller's allowance.
HATToken.burn(amount): burns tokens from the caller.
HATToken.permit(...): EIP-712 approval via ecrecover with deadline and nonce checks.
HATToken.transfer(dst, rawAmount): 96-bit safe transfer entry point.
HATToken.transferFrom(src, dst, rawAmount): allowance-consuming transfer with 96-bit safe math.
HATToken._mint(dst, rawAmount): CAP-checked supply and balance increase plus delegate movement.
HATToken._burn(src, rawAmount): supply and balance decrease plus delegate movement.
HATToken._moveDelegates(...): checkpoint-based vote accounting that can underflow/overflow on 96-bit math.
HATVaults.checkWithdrawRequest(pid): noPendingApproval/noSafetyPeriod gated validation of the withdraw window.
HATVaults.calcClaimRewards(pid, severity): computes every claim reward component from pool balance and split.
HATVaults.validateSplit(split): requires the six reward components to sum to 10000.
HATVaults.checkRewardsLevels(levels): validates each level is < 10000 or returns the default levels.
HATVaults.setWithdrawRequestParams(...): governance-only update of withdraw request timing.
HATVaults.setWithdrawSafetyPeriod(...): governance-only update of withdraw/safety periods.
HATVaults.setClaimFee(fee): governance-only update of the ETH claim fee.
HATVaults.setVestingParams(pid, duration, periods): governance-only LP reward vesting update.
HATVaults.setHatVestingParams(duration, periods): governance-only HAT reward vesting update.
HATVaults.setRewardsLevelsDelay(delay): governance-only timelock delay update (>= 2 days).
HATMaster.massUpdatePools(from, to): loops per-pool accrual of outstanding rewards.
TimelockController.updateDelay(newDelay): self-call-only update of the minimum delay.
HATTimelockController.approveClaim(pid): proposer-role wrapper forwarding to HATVaults.approveClaim.
HATTimelockController.addPool(...): proposer-role wrapper forwarding to HATVaults.addPool.
HATTimelockController.setPool(...): proposer-role wrapper forwarding to HATVaults.setPool.
HATTimelockController.swapBurnSend(...): proposer-role wrapper forwarding to HATVaults.swapBurnSend.
HATMaster.getMultiplier(from, to): block-range multiplier arithmetic over the 25-entry table.
HATMaster.calcPoolReward(pid, from, lastPoolUpdate): sums reward over totalAllocPoint update history.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller identity used for authorization checks and user accounting.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for safety periods, timelocks, vesting and signature deadlines.
lpToken.safeTransferFrom(...): external ERC20 pull from the user into the pool (external call / callback vector).
lpToken.safeTransfer(...): external ERC20 push to user, beneficiary, committee or token lock.
HAT.transfer(...): external HAT transfer for rewards and governance payouts.
HAT.mint(address(this), reward): external mint call driven by computed pool reward.
HAT.burn(burntHats): external burn call in swapBurnSend.
tokenLockFactory.createTokenLock(...): external factory call that deploys a vesting contract (reentrancy surface).
uniSwapRouter.exactInput(...): external Uniswap V3 swap with user-controlled path, fees and slippage limit.
target.call{value: value}(data): arbitrary low-level call in TimelockController._call.
ecrecover(...): signature recovery in permit/delegateBySig without malleability guard.
payable(governance()).transfer(msg.value): native ETH forwarding in claim, reverts on complex receivers.
_token.approve(router, amount): external approval of the swap router in swapTokenForHAT.
_pid of deposit/withdraw/emergencyWithdraw pool selector.
_amount deposited by the user.
_shares withdrawn by the user.
_beneficiary of a claim (pending approval or swap output).
_severity index into rewardsLevels of a pending approval.
_allocPoint of addPool.
_lpToken address registered in addPool.
_committee address of addPool.
_rewardsLevels array of addPool.
_rewardsSplit of addPool/setRewardsSplit.
_descriptionHash of addPool/setPool.
_rewardVestingParams [duration, periods] of addPool.
_newGovernance of setPendingGovernance.
_delay of setRewardsLevelsDelay.
_amountOutMinimum slippage bound of swapBurnSend.
_fees path fees of swapBurnSend.
newDelay of TimelockController.updateDelay.
pending reward computed in _deposit/_withdraw before payout.
factoredAmount share conversion in _deposit.
amountToWithdraw pro-rata conversion in _withdraw.
factoredBalance pro-rata conversion in _emergencyWithdraw.
claimRewards struct produced by calcClaimRewards and consumed by approveClaim.
hatsReceived swap output in swapBurnSend.
burntHats portion of hatsReceived burned in swapBurnSend.
tokenLock address created by the token lock factory in approveClaim/swapBurnSend.
operation id computed in execute/executeBatch.
hatBalance of the contract read in safeTransferReward.
reward amount computed in updatePool.
amountCanMint mint allowance cap read in updatePool.
spender local set to msg.sender in transferFrom.
amount local produced by safe96 in transfer/approve/permit.
signatory recovered from the signature in permit/delegateBySig.
totalSupply local (pool balance) in calcClaimRewards.
claimRewardAmount base amount in calcClaimRewards.
domainSeparator EIP-712 value.
structHash EIP-712 value.
path bytes built in swapTokenForHAT.
hatBalanceBefore snapshot used to verify swap output.

edges.reason: msg.sender keys userInfo and is the LP source for deposit.
msg.sender identifies the withdrawing user in withdraw.
approveClaim is gated by onlyGovernance comparing msg.sender to governance.
setPendingGovernance requires msg.sender to be the current governance.
transferGovernorship requires msg.sender to be the current governance.
pendingApprovalClaim requires committees[_pid] == msg.sender.
setCommittee branch selection depends entirely on msg.sender.
updateDelay requires msg.sender == address(this).
checkWithdrawRequest reads withdrawRequests keyed by msg.sender.
permit requires the recovered signatory to match the owner acting for msg.sender.
rewardDepositors pulls funds from msg.sender.
pendingApprovalClaim is only callable during the safety period derived from block.timestamp.
setRewardsLevels enforces setRewardsLevelsDelay via block.timestamp.
transferGovernorship enforces TIME_LOCK_DELAY via block.timestamp.
Withdraw window and safety period are computed from block.timestamp.
Claim vesting start/end timestamps derive from block.timestamp.
HAT vesting start/end timestamps derive from block.timestamp.
permit rejects expired signatures using block.timestamp <= deadline.
_schedule stores block.timestamp + delay into _timestamps.
Only governance may approve claims.
Governance handover is restricted to the stored governance.
Pending governance can only be set by governance.
addPool is governance-only.
setPool is governance-only.
swapBurnSend is governance-only.
setCommittee compares msg.sender to the governance address.
claim forwards the claim fee to governance().
approveClaim reads and deletes pendingApprovals.
pendingApprovalClaim writes the pendingApprovals entry.
approveClaim reads and reduces poolInfo balance.
swapBurnSend reads poolInfo lpToken.
updatePool mutates rewardPerShare, lastRewardBlock and lastProcessedTotalAllocPoint.
calcClaimRewards uses poolInfo balance and allocPoint.
swapAndBurns amount is consumed and zeroed in swapBurnSend.
governanceHatRewards amount is consumed and zeroed in swapBurnSend.
hackersHatRewards amount is consumed and zeroed in swapBurnSend.
checkWithdrawRequest validates and clears the stored withdraw request.
approveClaim reads pool vesting params from poolsRewards.
calcClaimRewards reads rewardsLevels and rewardsSplit.
setRewardsLevels copies pending levels into poolsRewards.
Withdraw window bounds and safety period come from generalParameters.
minimum deposit and pause parameters influence deposit acceptation.
setRewardsLevels confirms and deletes the pending reward levels.
mint allowance is the authorization check for HATToken.mint.
updatePool caps the computed reward by HAT.minters(address(this)).
_mint increases totalSupply under the CAP constraint.
_burn decreases totalSupply.
transfer updates the balances ledger.
transferFrom updates the balances ledger.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_burn debits the source balance.
execute relies on stored timestamps to decide readiness.
deposit reads/writes the caller userInfo entry.
withdraw reads/writes the caller userInfo entry.
onlyCommittee compares committees[_pid] to msg.sender.
committeeCheckIn is restricted to the pool committee.
setCommittee updates and validates the committees mapping.
tokenLockFactory is the target of createTokenLock.
uniSwapRouter is the target of exactInput.
poolDepositPause blocks deposit when set.
safeTransferReward uses HAT balance and transfers HAT.
swapTokenForHAT compares token addresses against HAT and reads its balance.
HAT transfers flow through the HAT token reference.
HAT minting flows through the HAT token reference.
HAT burning flows through the HAT token reference.
deposit delegates accounting to _deposit.
withdraw validates the withdraw request first.
withdraw delegates accounting to _withdraw.
emergencyWithdraw validates the withdraw request first.
emergencyWithdraw delegates to _emergencyWithdraw.
_deposit accrues the pool before updating user state.
_deposit pays pending rewards.
_withdraw accrues the pool before payout.
_withdraw pays pending rewards.
updatePool uses calcPoolReward for the elapsed range.
calcPoolReward accumulates products of multiplier, reward per block and allocation points.
approveClaim computes rewards via calcClaimRewards.
addPool validates rewards levels.
addPool validates the rewards split.
setRewardsSplit validates the split before storing.
setPendingRewardsLevels validates the levels.
claim forwards msg.value to the governance address.
permit recovers the signatory with ecrecover.
HATToken.mint calls _mint.
HATToken.burn calls _burn.
mint moves delegates for the recipient.
burn moves delegates away from the source.
transfer moves delegates between accounts.
transferFrom moves delegates between accounts.
execute performs the operation call through _call.
Timelock wrapper forwards approveClaim under PROPOSER_ROLE.
Timelock wrapper forwards addPool under PROPOSER_ROLE.
Timelock wrapper forwards setPool under PROPOSER_ROLE.
Timelock wrapper forwards swapBurnSend under PROPOSER_ROLE.
swapBurnSend swaps LP tokens through swapTokenForHAT.
swapTokenForHAT calls the Uniswap router exactInput.
_call executes an arbitrary low-level call.
_afterCall writes _DONE_TIMESTAMP into _timestamps.
massUpdatePools loops over updatePool.
_deposit writes user.amount and user.rewardDebt.
_deposit increases pool balance and totalUsersAmount.
_withdraw decreases user.amount and recomputes rewardDebt.
_withdraw subtracts the pro-rata amount from pool balance; underflow/rounding sensitive.
_emergencyWithdraw zeroes user.amount and rewardDebt.
approveClaim deletes the consumed pending approval.
approveClaim accrues the swapAndBurn amount.
approveClaim accrues the governance HAT reward amount.
approveClaim accrues the hacker HAT reward amount.
approveClaim subtracts the summed claim rewards from the pool balance; underflow risk.
swapBurnSend resets swapAndBurns for the token.
swapBurnSend resets governanceHatRewards for the token.
swapBurnSend resets hackersHatRewards for the beneficiary.
updatePool computes reward*1e12/totalUsersAmount and adds it to rewardPerShare.
setRewardsLevels writes the confirmed levels into poolsRewards.
setRewardsLevels deletes the pending reward levels.
setPendingRewardsLevels writes levels and timestamp.
pendingApprovalClaim stores the pending approval entry.
rewardDepositors increases the pool balance.
setPendingGovernance stores governancePending next to the governance state.
transferGovernorship overwrites the governance address.
setCommittee rewrites the committee for the pool.
updateDelay does not touch generalParameters directly but governs the timelock applied to it; recorded as related state write.
setWithdrawRequestParams writes withdraw request timings.
setWithdrawSafetyPeriod writes withdraw and safety periods.
setClaimFee writes the claim fee.
setVestingParams writes pool vesting duration and periods.
setHatVestingParams writes HAT vesting parameters.
setRewardsLevelsDelay writes the timelock delay parameter.
calcClaimRewards multiplies balance by level and split then divides by 10000*10000.
_deposit pulls LP tokens with safeTransferFrom.
rewardDepositors pulls LP tokens with safeTransferFrom.
_withdraw pushes LP tokens with safeTransfer.
_emergencyWithdraw pushes LP tokens with safeTransfer.
approveClaim performs several LP token safeTransfer calls.
approveClaim creates a vesting token lock for the hacker.
swapBurnSend creates a vesting token lock for HAT rewards.
swapBurnSend transfers HAT to the token lock and to governance.
swapBurnSend burns part of the received HAT.
safeTransferReward transfers HAT to the user.
updatePool mints the accrued reward to the master contract.
swapTokenForHAT approves the router to spend the LP token.
A malicious LP token can re-enter deposit during safeTransferFrom before accounting is finalized.
A malicious LP token can re-enter withdraw during safeTransfer.
HAT transfer during reward payout can re-enter deposit.
tokenLockFactory is external and could re-enter approveClaim, which is only partially guarded.
Uniswap router callbacks could re-enter swapBurnSend before all state resets complete.
Arbitrary target call in the timelock can re-enter approveClaim.
Arbitrary target call in the timelock can re-enter swapBurnSend.
Arbitrary target call in the timelock can re-enter withdraw.
The deposit amount parameter feeds _deposit and the minimum deposit check.
The shares parameter feeds the withdraw accounting.
The severity parameter selects the reward level used by approveClaim.
The delay parameter controls the rewards-level timelock length.
The slippage bound parameter is propagated to the router swap.
The fee tiers parameter builds the swap path.
The pending reward local is passed to safeTransferReward.
The claimRewards struct is produced by calcClaimRewards and consumed by approveClaim.
The hatsReceived local holds the swap output returned to swapBurnSend.
The operation id local is derived from the hashed operation parameters.

normalization_plan.reason: _pid merely selects the pool for the deposit entry point and is not independently security relevant.
The deposit amount is only meaningful inside fn_deposit accounting.
The shares value is only meaningful inside fn_withdraw accounting.
The claim beneficiary is a parameter of the approveClaim payout flow.
The severity index is used exclusively to select reward levels in approveClaim.
The allocation point is consumed by the addPool registration flow.
The LP token address is consumed by the addPool registration flow.
The committee address is consumed by the addPool registration flow.
The rewards levels array is validated and stored by addPool.
The rewards split is validated and stored by addPool.
The description hash is only emitted metadata for addPool.
The vesting params array is validated and stored by addPool.
The new governance address parameter belongs to setPendingGovernance.
The delay parameter belongs to setRewardsLevelsDelay.
The slippage bound parameter belongs to swapBurnSend.
The fee tiers parameter belongs to swapBurnSend.
The newDelay parameter belongs to TimelockController.updateDelay.
The pending reward local is the amount paid out by safeTransferReward.
The factored share amount only exists inside _deposit accounting.
The pro-rata withdraw amount only exists inside _withdraw.
The factored balance only exists inside _emergencyWithdraw.
The claimRewards struct is the direct return value of calcClaimRewards.
hatsReceived is the return value of swapTokenForHAT.
burntHats is only used to drive the HAT burn inside swapBurnSend.
The tokenLock address is produced by the createTokenLock call inside approveClaim.
The operation id local is scoped to timelock execute bookkeeping.
The HAT balance local is read and capped inside safeTransferReward.
The reward local is computed and minted inside updatePool.
The mint allowance local caps the reward inside updatePool.
The spender local is set from msg.sender inside transferFrom.
The amount local is the 96-bit converted value inside transfer/approve.
The signatory local is recovered and checked inside permit.
The totalSupply local is the pool balance read inside calcClaimRewards.
The claimRewardAmount local is the base amount computed in calcClaimRewards.
The domainSeparator local is built inside permit/delegateBySig.
The structHash local is built inside permit/delegateBySig.
The path bytes local is constructed inside swapTokenForHAT.
The hatBalanceBefore snapshot is used only inside swapTokenForHAT.
